description:
Nearest cross street: Situated at a point in the northeasterly line of Martin Avenue (50 feet wide) distant 265.12 feet southeasterly along the same from its intersection with the southeasterly line of Major Street
Dimensions (approx): 50 x 105 feet
Amount due for taxes: As of August 13, 2025, the first, second and third quarter 2025 taxes are paid with the fourth quarter taxes to be determined on or about November 1, 2025, and first and second quarter 2026 taxes to be determined on or about February 1, 2026 and May 1, 2026, respectively. Water and sewer for the fourth quarter of 2025 are paid, subject to final reading. The Amount Due can be obtained from the Local Taxing Authority.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Passaic County Register's office on September 6, 2017 in Mortgage Book 14656 at Page 270, et seq., Paterson, New Jersey, and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Passaic County
